description: [low-level] Fetch node structure from ADT repository. Used for object tree navigation and structure discovery. Can use session_id and session_state from GetSession to maintain the same session.

node_id.description: Optional node ID (default: "000000", the root). Use to fetch child nodes. "0000" is not the root: E19 answers it with an empty body.

session_id.description: Session ID from GetSession. If not provided, a new session will be created.

session_state.description: Session state from GetSession (cookies, csrf_token, cookie_store). Required if session_id is provided.

name: GetNodeStructureLow
